adjudication.rationale: The newly added webhook endpoint `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` authenticates requests only by checking a shared secret header value (`req.headers[... ] !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and then blindly decrypts/applies `reqBody.keys` to update/create credentials. There is no timestamp/nonce/idempotency key, signature over the payload, or other anti-replay mechanism, so a previously captured valid request could be replayed later to re-apply older/stale encrypted keys (credential rollback). The equality check is also a plain string comparison rather than constant-time, which can additionally leak information via timing, though the replay issue is directly verifiable from the diff.
